verdict.rationale: Sift's docs describe a dedicated sandbox environment with its own sandbox REST API keys and a separate sandbox console view. Developers can send test events without affecting production scores. This is true environment isolation, not a dry-run mode. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox's isolation, and details on how sandbox behavior differs from production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: This sandbox environment allows you to send test events or client data to Sift without impacting the scores Sift produces in production.
Use your Sandbox REST API key for accessing Sandbox users when testing. Switch to your Production API key for your live integration
Selecting sandbox mode will switch you to the sandbox view so you can see all your test data in the console
